picks.title: Hacker awarded $50k bounty for reporting bug to Sony that allowed PS5 Linux exploit — move sparks backlash from jailbreaking community
picks.summary: The hypervisor bug that allowed PS5 users to install Linux on their consoles was patched before the launch of GTA VI, meaning they have to choose between experimenting with Linux and running the game.

picks.title: Warp discloses breach exposing AI agent logs, user telemetry data
picks.summary: Agent decision logs and telemetry data belonging to Warp agentic development environment users were exposed in an attack on a third-party vendor in the project s infrastructure. [...]

picks.title: Crypto wallet maker Keystone to destroy almost 19,000 devices after security breach
Japan s GMO urges customers to shut down PCs amid ransomware threat
picks.summary: The GMO Group has urged customers to disconnect their systems from the internet and shut down computers after a threat actor who breached the company s Onamae Desktop Cloud threatened to launch a ransomware attack today. [...]

picks.title: UNM Health ransomware attack disrupts patient care, surgeries
picks.summary: The University of New Mexico Health Sciences Center disclosed a cyberattack that caused system outages and disrupted patient care and academic activities. [...]

picks.title: Data Recovery CEO Indicted for Allegedly Scamming Ransomware Victims
Bitcoin Wallet Maker Keystone Pulls Devices as Stolen Key Opens Door to Fakes
picks.summary: Attackers obtained the factory key that proves Keystone s hardware wallets are genuine, and 25,964 buyer records were affected. The company says recovery phrases and private keys were not involved.

picks.title: Tranche Vault on Avalanche Drained of 1.01 Million USDC
picks.summary: Blockaid says a flash loan let the attacker mint inflated tranche shares and redeem the vault s USDC. A balance check showed none left in the identified contract.

picks.title: US Charges Six in Alleged Madagascar NFT Wallet-Draining Scheme
picks.summary: An FBI affidavit estimates at least $516,695 in losses across 74 victim-linked wallets and describes unlimited USDT spending approvals.

picks.title: U.S. agency hits Utah with lawsuit to shield Kalshi s ability to offer betting there
Bitcoin shows signs of weakness while Ripple s bank win fails to bolster XRP
Nvidia is bankrolling AI accelerator supply chain buildout to reserve production capacity
picks.summary: Nvidia is committing billions to expand substrate, co-packaged optics, advanced packaging, and chip-testing capacity through 2028, reserving capacity at nearly every stage of its AI accelerator supply chain.
